en.headline: Happy Valley opens a three-week Oktoberfest on race night
en.dek: The Jockey Club says tonight's Happy Wednesday meeting starts an Oktoberfest programme, with a ceremony at 6pm led by the German consul.
body: The Hong Kong Jockey Club said Happy Wednesday at Happy Valley Racecourse would open an Oktoberfest programme on Wednesday, with Beerfest nights to follow on 14 and 21 October. The club said the opening ceremony at 6pm would be led by Annika Bolten-Drutschmann, Consul General of Germany to Hong Kong and Macau, and Winfried Engelbrecht-Bresges, the club's chief executive.

The club said the German folk group Die Notenhobler would play Bavarian music on the opening night, alongside a beer-tasting challenge and photo installations. Public-enclosure admission is 10 dollars, paid by Octopus at entrance G, the club said.

The programme sits on the club's midweek race meetings, which usually run on Wednesday nights from September to July. Gates open two hours before the first race. The club said hospitality packages are sold separately from general admission.

zh.headline: 跑馬地周三賽事揭幕德國啤酒節 一連三周
zh.dek: 馬會表示今晚Happy Wednesday以德國啤酒節揭幕，下午6時由德國總領事及馬會行政總裁主持開幕禮。
body: 香港賽馬會表示，跑馬地馬場周三的Happy Wednesday將以德國啤酒節揭幕，其後10月14日及21日則為啤酒節賽馬夜。馬會稱，下午6時的開幕禮由德國駐香港及澳門總領事寶德雅及馬會行政總裁應家柏主持。
馬會表示，開幕夜有德國民俗樂隊Die Notenhobler演奏巴伐利亞音樂，並設啤酒品味挑戰及拍照裝置。公眾席入場費10元，可用八達通在G入口繳付。
活動屬馬會周三夜賽安排。馬季一般由9月至翌年7月，通常在周三晚上舉行，閘口於頭場開跑前兩小時開放。馬會另設款待組合，與普通入場分開發售。
